subunit: Forms a heterodimer (via TM13) with PDZK1IP1 (via N-terminal transmembrane helix); this interaction enhances SLC5A2 transporter activity

complexes.name: SGLT2-MAP17 glucose cotransporter complex
complexes.function: Na+-coupled sugar simporter that actively transports D-glucose at the plasma membrane and is responsible for reabsorption of glucose in the kidney proximal tubules after filtration through the glomerulus. SGLT2/SLC5A2 binds a single Na2+ ion and undergoes a resulting conformational change which enablies the protein to bind one sugar molecule.
complexes.properties: Na+-sugar symport involves a conformational equilibrium between outward-facing and inward-facing protein conformations, through opening and closing of external and internal barriers composed by hydrophobic side-chains of inner transmembrane helices. Na+ binding to the outward-facing conformation is required to open an external gate and consequently allow the sugar to reach its substrate-binding site; then, the outer gate closes, blocking the sugar into the binding pocket, and subsequently the opening of an inner gate allows both Na+ and sugar to reach the cytoplasm. Finally, the inner gate closes and the protein isomerizes to its initial conformation. MAP17 /PDZK1IP1 helps to form a fixed scaffold that stabilizes SGLT2 in th eplasma membrane..
